newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P affirms Daiwa Sec's ratings, outlook negative.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms Daiwa Sec's ratings, outlook negative.

text.p: Standard and Poor's said on Wednesday that it had affirmed its A/A-1 ratings and the negative outlook of Daiwa Securities Co Ltd and its affiliates.

On Monday, Daiwa said it would provide 120 billion yen in financial aid to a finance affiliate, Daiwa Finance Co Ltd. The 120 billion yen would be posted as an extraordinary loss in this business year, the brokerage said.

S&P said in a statement that the loss was within the range of its earlier estimate, but added that Daiwa would have to use all of this fiscal year's operating profits, as well as certain reserves and unrealised gains on its stock portfolio, to fund the support.
S&P said it remained concerned about the changing competitive environment for Japanese securities firms amid ongoing deregulation and the potentially negative impact on participants' risk profits.
